concept: A painted restaurant. Clawd is the hungry customer (your app), a waiter Clawd in a bow tie is the API, and the kitchen behind the swinging doors is the server. The camera glides from table to kitchen and back in one move; the order ticket is the prop that travels through every chapter.
shows_off: motivated camera (it follows the ticket), two characters in different colours, iris transition into the kitchen, a pull-back reveal at the end

lines.text: You use APIs every single day, and nobody ever explains them like this.
Picture a restaurant. You're at the table. That's your app.
The kitchen has the food. That's the server, with all the data.
You can't walk into the kitchen. So a waiter takes your order, and brings back your food.
That waiter is the API. It carries requests in, and answers back out.
Follow for more tech, explained like you're five.
